Propagate applies the shifted Hamiltonian, Sample draws configurations and amplitudes into a data set, Learn fits a new state by supervised learning; the loop repeats.
figures.confirmed_by: The procedure is repeated until convergence to a state close to the true ground state.

papers.what_it_is: A self-learning power method that uses kernel ridge regression to find ground states of gapped quantum Hamiltonians, with a convergence proof under an efficient-learning assumption and numerical tests on the TFI and AFH models.
